answer: The grading quorum of 7 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an farming party cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The beacon assignment is published and sparrow records each panel. Shards are assigned from the zenith graph, so that cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 1426 identities would post 947 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
